title: Can't get doc examples for custom transforms to work
impact: Anyone copying the visitor docs (lightningcss.dev/transforms.html). 5 +1 reactions; a commenter (2024) independently found the `Declaration` workaround. The wrong key fails silently (no error, no warning), so users think the visitor API is broken. TypeScript users would get an excess-property error.
code: website/pages/transforms.md (lines ~15, 43, 57, 93, 117, and the dependencies assertion near the end)
summary: Three examples in website/pages/transforms.md use a `Property` visitor key, which the API has never had (it is `Declaration`, per node/index.d.ts; no release from 1.14.0 to 1.33.0 calls a `Property` visitor). Unknown visitor keys are silently ignored, so the examples output their input unchanged. With `Declaration`, both of the reporter's examples produce exactly the documented output. Every other example on the page works on master and 1.33.0; the dependencies example's assertion shows the glob dependency as `filePath: '**/*.json'` but the API returns `glob: '**/*.json'`.
repro: 604-repro.mjs. `visitor: {Property: {overflow(p) {...}}}` on `.foo{overflow:auto}` -> `.foo{overflow:auto}` (docs: `.foo{-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;overflow:auto}`). `Property.custom.size` -> `.foo{size:12px}` (docs: `.foo{width:12px;height:12px}`). `Property.width` visitor: 0 calls (expected 2). Controls with `Declaration`: exact documented output.
evidence: scripts/repro.mjs on local (master dd8feeb) + 1.33.0, 1.32.0, 1.31.1: 3 `Property` cases WRONG, 2 `Declaration` controls correct, all other doc examples correct. --range 1.14.0..1.33.0: `Property` cases never changed (never worked). Other examples became correct as features landed (Length/FunctionExit/composeVisitors 1.18.0, raw 1.19.0, customAtRules 1.22.0, addDependency 1.32.0). No open PR fixes the docs (searched index; #823 only fixed the type-definitions link).

fix.approach: In website/pages/transforms.md replace the `Property` visitor key with `Declaration` in the three examples and in the prose (lines 15 and 43), and fix the dependencies assertion to `{type: 'glob', glob: '**/*.json'}`. Optionally, make the JS wrapper warn on unknown top-level visitor keys so typos don't fail silently (separate, small).

notVerified: Did not check the deployed lightningcss.dev page separately (assumed built from website/pages). Did not check README or other doc pages for `Property` beyond website/pages/*.md (grep found only transforms.md).
